title: Miners Pivot, Crisis Incoming
script_summary:
Marathon just dumped fifteen thousand Bitcoin—not bearish, strategic. They're chasing better returns in AI infrastructure. That's your first signal: corporate capital is front-running a structural break.

Signal two hits harder. The private credit market just became the only lender that matters. The Fed's irrelevant now. And 2026 brings the largest corporate bond issuance wall in history, landing exactly when refinancing pressure peaks and liquidity thins. Nobody's mapping what happens when that
